value.rationale: The model has a specific natural dependence question: shared instantaneous resets typically correlate all searchers. The theorem classifies the complete asymptotic finite-population joint law and proves an exact decorrelation boundary where the endogenous reset duration changes from infinite to finite mean; above threshold the positive pair covariance has a sharp closed coefficient for the canonical speed family. These facts cannot be read off from the finite-mean single-particle uniform law.
